MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 101.88 is moderate. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.462 is a weekly reading for Nov 6, not a live measure.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today: Chicago Fed NFCI at 8:30 AM, housing starts at 8:30 AM, and Pending Home Sales and New York Fed Outlook-at-Risk at 10:00 AM; EIA petroleum data at 10:30 AM. Treasury supply includes a 20-year bond auction at 1:00 PM; FOMC minutes at 2:00 PM are minutes, not a policy decision.
  • Funding/financial conditions: SOFR 3.93% effective Nov 16; NFCI -0.462 for week ending Nov 6; MOVE 101.88 on Nov 17; 10-year Treasury 5.10% on Nov 17. SOFR and NFCI are lagged observations, not live funding measures. The next NFCI release is scheduled today for the week ending Nov 13.
  • Treasury duration supply: 20-year bond auction Nov 18 and 9-year 8-month TIPS auction Nov 19, both competitive bids close at 1:00 PM ET; these may matter for duration/rates positioning. H.4.1 is scheduled Thu Nov 19 at 4:30 PM ET.
  • Key subsequent catalysts: BEA PCE Dec 2 at 8:30 AM, Employment Situation Dec 4 at 8:30 AM, FOMC statement Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference 2:30 PM, CPI Dec 10 and PPI Dec 15, both at 8:30 AM. CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
  • Energy schedule: EIA petroleum report today and Nov 25 at 10:30 AM; natural gas storage Nov 19 at 10:30 AM and Thanksgiving-adjusted Nov 25 at noon ET.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed November calendar places Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM, while BEA's direct schedule identifies October Personal Income and Outlays on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM and the New York Fed December calendar also lists Dec 2. We use the BEA-confirmed Dec 2 date and do not duplicate PCE on Nov 25; the disagreement is flagged. BEA and the New York Fed calendar agree on Q3 GDP second release Nov 25 at 8:30 AM.
  • NAR's official Pending Home Sales page gives Nov 18 at 10:00 AM ET but contains September and October release-period text. The period is therefore not stated. Census confirms October housing starts today and October durable goods and new home sales Nov 25. The Chicago Fed calendar confirms CFNAI Nov 23 at 8:30 AM; it is not date-only.
  • bls.gov was not requested. BLS release dates and times for Employment Situation, CPI and PPI were checked on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. There are no remaining BLS-key release rows in the verified Nov 18-24 window; the verified December dates are displayed. Calendar dates may change.
  • Selected releases from checked primary calendars, not exhaustive. Fed statistical releases listed selectively (H.4.1 and H.8); other statistical series and events are omitted. Only verified Treasury auctions are included. EIA petroleum schedule uses the standard Wednesday 10:30 AM release following its Nov 12 Veterans Day exception; natural gas Nov 25 at noon is the Thanksgiving exception.
  • Unmatched classifier events are kept as provisional Medium with review notes; no overrides. Sources checked: New York Fed November/December calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendars and H.4.1; U.S. Census Bureau; BEA; NAR; EIA; TreasuryDirect; U.S. Treasury; Chicago Fed NFCI data and release calendar; Philadelphia Fed; Dallas Fed; Conference Board; University of Michigan. Market snapshot quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this was not a full headline-risk review. Energy inventory releases and Treasury auctions are the identified near-term supply and market-structure watch items.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Tuesday's SPY close fell 1.02%, VIX rose to 25.46, and MOVE edged higher to 101.88; the 10-year yield eased 2 bp to 5.10%. ES is modestly higher in overnight trade versus Tuesday's completed bar. NFCI, housing data, later energy data and FOMC minutes make today event-sensitive; monitor rates, breadth and liquidity rather than extrapolating the overnight quote. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if today's data or Fed minutes materially reprice yields, volatility broadens around energy or Treasury supply, or ES price action lacks confirmation from breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify intended contract specifications before execution.
